∀ (p : outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.Public) (C E : ℝ),
  0 < p.m →
    0 < p.n →
      0 < C →
        0 < p.Δ →
          0 < p.ε →
            0 ≤ p.σ →
              E ≤ p.Δ →
                have r := ↑(min p.m p.n);
                have K := ↑(outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.horizon p C);
                have β := outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.momentum p C;
                have η := outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.stepSize p C;
                E / (K * η) + C * η / 2 + 2 * p.σ * √(r * (1 - β)) / √(1 + β) + 2 * β * p.σ * √r / ((1 - β) * K) +
                    2 * η * β * C / (1 - β) ≤
                  p.ε
